title: applywarp
description: Apply warps estimated by FNIRT (or some other software) to some image.

relwarp.description: Treat warp field as relative: x' = x + w(x).
relwarp.title: Relwarp

abswarp.description: Treat warp field as absolute: x' = w(x).
abswarp.title: Abswarp

datatype.description: 'char' or 'short' or 'int' or 'float' or 'double'. Force output data type [char short int float double].
datatype.title: Datatype

mask_file.description: Filename for mask image (in reference space).
mask_file.title: Mask file

output_type.description: 'nifti' or 'nifti_pair' or 'nifti_gz' or 'nifti_pair_gz'. Fsl output type.
output_type.title: Output type

superlevel.description: 'a' or an integer. Level of intermediary supersampling, a for 'automatic' or integer level. default = 2.
superlevel.title: Superlevel

superlevel_2.description: 'a' or an integer. Level of intermediary supersampling, a for 'automatic' or integer level. default = 2.
superlevel_2.title: Superlevel

supersample.description: Intermediary supersampling of output, default is off.
supersample.title: Supersample
